notes:
Passed on the fake backend by python3 -m mhs.driver check (evidence contract_checked, never an MHS-Device level). Model-authored and unreviewed. The card's family-config GymnasiumDriver is used, but it declares no env_id and no sim backend: internutopia.core.gym_env:Env is constructed from a Config and is not registered with gymnasium.make, and its runner starts isaacsim.SimulationApp (runner.py:477-486), so Isaac Sim was not installed, imported or run. The fake backend is the package's own pure-Python kinematic stand-in (fake.py) and was not compared with the upstream environment; the sim path was not run. NOT COVERED: rigid-body dynamics, contacts, actuators, controllers, sensors, cameras, noise and wall-clock pacing; the fake only sets position and orientation from the supplied path points, keeps orientation at identity and reports reward 0.0 with no termination model. The fake interprets the action-space object directly (upstream Env.step wraps it under the robot name and dispatches it to controllers, gym_env.py:130-131), and its observation is the hardcoded observation_space shape rather than the configured robot's observation mapping (gym_env.py:84-85 and 136-137). fidelity.timestep_ms is the SimConfig physics_dt default (1/60 s, config/__init__.py:21), not a measured interval of the fake. The bridge publishes the action space's Sequence(Tuple(Box x3)) member move_along_path as an unstructured object with no finite limits, so G8 SAFE-014 has nothing to probe and the suite awards CL2; no bound was invented to change that. Upstream Env.reset accepts seed and options but uses neither (gym_env.py:62-87), so the fidelity contract declares determinism none and the fake keeps a fixed start pose; cap.world.seed.v1 is still served by the bridge and reaches no native call (G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL). Expected warnings: G6.NO_NATIVE_CALL for cap.world.seed.v1, G8.SAFE014_NOT_APPLICABLE, and G8.NO_UNIT x3 (the bridge derives ticks and the two seed integers without a unit). Only catalogue cap.world.reset.v1, cap.world.step.v1 and cap.world.seed.v1 are used, so there are no catalogue requests. gate.digest is the digest the check printed; check-report.json is regenerated by every gate run and is not part of the package.
